qualityFindings.impact: The stale 06:05:30 draft was preserved and superseded before event merges because snapshot acceptance came later than its timestamp. The corrected run was retimed to 06:50 with acceptance at 13:15:26.504Z before issuance, restoring exact benchmark comparisons.

Los Angeles Kings moneyline at DraftKings 1.64 was rejected. MoneyPuck's 67.3965% point was isolated; the exact Pinnacle no-vig reference was 59.0286%, making the executable comparison -1.94697 percentage points, while DRatings, Dimers, goalie status and Kempe availability did not corroborate a wager.

Critical review removed provisional WAIT/LEAN labels for Pelicans, Houston, Portland, Atlanta-Washington totals, Chicago-Florida puck line and several moneylines. Five favorable market-benchmark cases were retained as PASS only after explicit market-route review; a market benchmark was not treated as independent fair value.

All 58 immutable captured forecast observations received current-report applicability bindings. None was adopted as exact fair evidence because current personnel, starter or goalie incorporation was not disclosed by the publisher; original model and observation clocks were preserved.

Four researchers returned complete event work for 21 events and all 126 moneyline, spread/run/puck-line and total selections. Two reviewers completed disjoint review passes; no supported BET or LEAN survived reconciliation.
